description: This file defines Joi validation schemas for exam-related data structures, including database schemas, generated exams, user completed exams, and exam results, along with validation functions.

methods.name: validateExamFromDbSchema
methods.description: Validates an exam object from the database against the Joi schema.

methods.name: validateGeneratedExamSchema
methods.description: Validates a generated exam object against the Joi schema, ensuring the number of questions matches.

methods.name: validateUserCompletedExamSchema
methods.description: Validates a user's completed exam data against the Joi schema, ensuring question count matches.

methods.name: validateExamResultsSchema
methods.description: Validates exam results data against the Joi schema.
